description: Patient takes cetirizine 10 mg daily for seasonal allergies
presentation: Patient is a 44-year old man who had a positive quantiferon as part of a routine medical examination given he is from an endemic country. He has no symptoms and no known TB exposures. His chest-xray was negative for infection during his clinic visit today. He takes cetirizine 10 mg daily for seasonal allergies. He would like to delay TB treatment if not absolutely necessary for at least a few months. Does this patient need immediate TB treatment and if so, with what regimen?
